rationale: The assistant correctly tied Er03 to liquid on the controls and gave a safe clean, dry and power-cycle fix, matching the ground truth. It conditioned escalation on the fault persisting and told the customer not to open the hob. It asked no questions, though, and it also stated a specific 10-second detail and a possible 'touch control board' moisture fault, which are slightly beyond the evidence but hedged. It also gave a specific AEG phone number whose accuracy can't be verified here.
